verdicts.title: Retire the finished tab-migration seam: one reach table, an exhaustive panel map
verdicts.ambition_why: A hygiene move, but the right one: it turns two shipped-bug classes (404 rail link, blank panel) into tsc errors instead of adding a fourth hand-list.
verdicts.grounding_why: Every anchor holds on the tree (seam comment :444, 28-vs-29 ids, 26-branch chain, stale comments in OrgTabChunks/loading, vacuous test :362-366, grep of callers exact).
verdicts.falsifiability_why: Alias href, derived not-in-nav set, export removal and the @ts-expect-error fixture are red today and cannot pass by accident; acceptance 5 (page render per panel id) needs getOrgHeaderSummary/countInFlightPrs/canReadOrg mocked and will outgrow its ~70-line estimate.
verdicts.notes: Floors pass (M/6/7/5, 10 files, 7 cases, architecture gate, no wire or auth change). orgTabAliasTarget survives as a derivation, which about.json#0 depends on; sequence this before that card or keep the export name. Only loading.tsx comment edit; legacy redirect stubs untouched.

verdicts.title: Decide a heatmap cell's next step in place: tracked status, start/done/dismiss
verdicts.revise: The repo-dimension GET gates on canReadOrg (read), the PATCH on requireOrgAccess (write): have the route return `canAct` (the viewer's write access, resolved server-side beside the read gate) and make actionsFor() return [] when canAct is false, so a read-only viewer is never offered Start/Done/Dismiss that will 403 - add the case to the model tests.
verdicts.ambition_why: Turns a read-only drill-in that reports wrong state (dismissed shown as open) into the decision point on three surfaces, through the existing gated door - the move a principal makes rather than a new endpoint.
verdicts.grounding_why: Route :57-59 has no status filter, roadmap mapping :1405-1421 drops id/status, getLatestRecommendations and the PATCH route exist as described (modal line cites shifted by 3, immaterial).
verdicts.falsifiability_why: Route/model/dom cases are red today (route never calls getLatestRecommendations; modal has no PATCH); the double-press and 403-not-optimistic cases catch the usual wrong builds.
verdicts.notes: Floors pass (M/6/8/5, 7 files, 8 cases, contract gate; `nextSteps` kept so the only consumer is unaffected). No new authorization surface: writes go through resolve-then-gate PATCH. The revise is the one gap: controls are offered on role the client cannot see.

verdicts.title: One repo-history read ladder for /trends, /report/compare and /api/history
verdicts.ambition_why: An extraction, but one that fixes two real drifts (compare depth 60 vs cap 200 silently substituting ?a/?b; sign-in next dropping the pair) rather than only relocating code.
verdicts.grounding_why: All anchors verified: hiddenByWindow in exactly two pages, compare :101 limit 60, trends :114 cap, scans-read ids.has at :767/:783, next at compare :51, route :80 vs signin-gate :41, and the three cited commits each touched both pages.
verdicts.falsifiability_why: Module absent, depth and next-path cases red; the io-free ladder is tested through injected reads so each state is pinned; the existing page/route suites act as guards. The 'other errors propagate' rule is pinned by one case only.
verdicts.notes: Floors pass (M/6/7/5, 6 files, 7 cases, architecture gate). /api/history is consumed in-repo (DimensionTrends) and in docs/API.md, not by action.yml; status codes unchanged, header additive, sign-in predicates byte-identical. docs/adr/2026-10-09 cites the per-page line ranges and will go stale (docs only). Enables trends.json#1 pairs past the 60th scan.

verdicts.title: Trends explains its own moves: every event and any two points open their diff
verdicts.ambition_why: Closes the gap between 'fell 7 points' and the attributed diff the product already computes - one click to the explanation, plus a pick-two mode nothing in the app offers today.
verdicts.grounding_why: annotations.ts :81 keeps only now.id with prev in scope, deployAnnotations :57 computes and discards older, TrendChart :114 push-only, no compare link in src carries a=/b=, isCompactedPointId at :344 - all exact.
verdicts.falsifiability_why: Pure pickReducer/pairCompareHref cases (role order, self-pair and compacted refusal) and the onPick-vs-push dom case are red today and catch the obvious wrong builds; the range-toggle clear case is the weakest, pinned by one dom test.
verdicts.notes: Floors pass (M/6/8/5, 10 files, 7 cases, direction gate, no wire change). LOC: TrendChart 276 and DimensionTrends 284 cross 300 unless the planned extractions (lines 143-167 annotation marks; 224-278 card grid, retry handler passed as prop) happen first - verified the ranges hold what the card says. Land after trends.json#0 or accept the existing 'no longer in the comparison window' notice for deep pairs.

verdicts.title: Fleet scans get the post-scan consequences interactive scans get: one module
verdicts.ambition_why: Finds that the majority of an org's scans (cadence, push, Scan-all, import) never feed the adoption ledger or memory and that the degrade guard is push-only - fixing the rule once where four executors re-derived subsets.
verdicts.grounding_why: reconcilePracticeAdoption/recordScanMemories have exactly one caller (scan-finalize :220/:233), worker :362 is `push && !inferenceBilled`, :372-378 persist+alert only, import head :578-585 bare persist, cron/push/scan-all all drain the same lane, 93ccd721 introduced the push-only branch - all exact.
verdicts.falsifiability_why: Six cases are red today and pin both the new consequences and the generalised degrade guard; the deduped and throwing-reconcile cases catch the two likeliest wrong builds; guards keep the mock-requested and interactive paths pinned.
verdicts.notes: Floors pass (M/6/8/5, 10 files, 6 cases, architecture gate). Billing unchanged: a degraded cadence scan is refunded today and after (shouldRefundScan on provider mock). Behaviour shift to state in the doc: a degraded cadence scan now takes the 6h failure backoff (advanceScheduleAfterFailure + inFailureBackoff) instead of the full weekly slot - more retries during an outage, each reserve+refund, same pattern the no-token path already uses. import/route.ts is 706 lines and grows ~6; the runner-up (one executor) is the real fix for that file.

verdicts.title: A finished fleet scan leaves a roster: failures named by fix, one-click retry
verdicts.ambition_why: Solid UX closure of a data-discarding hook, but it is the obvious move once the frames are seen; the runner-up (pre-flight preview) is the bigger one.
verdicts.grounding_why: Button :70 count-only copy, hook :83-85 increments, scan route :214 emits repo/error/charged, queue route :59 drops error/creditCharged which ScanJobRow carries, reattach validator checks repo/state only, ScanScope already takes repos - all exact.
verdicts.falsifiability_why: Fold/dedupe/retryScope/charged cases are pure and red; the queue-route case pins the additive fields; the retryFailed case pins exactly one startScan with the failed set.
verdicts.notes: Floors pass (M/6/7/4, 9 files, 7 cases, contract gate; queue response is additive and consumed only by useOrgScanButton and useImportReattach). Nothing about what is charged moves - retry is an ordinary scoped POST. src/components/org/shared is outside src/features (300 cap), sizes fine.

verdicts.title: One effective-policy resolver: fleet view and MCP verdict fold admission too
verdicts.revise: Add src/lib/mcp/handlers.fleet.test.ts and src/lib/org/governance.test.ts to the write set and extend their @/lib/db/org-admission mocks with listOrgAdmissions (returning []), otherwise the fleet resolver's new read breaks those suites; and pin acceptance 5 to ONE behaviour (admissionUnread: true, since listOrgAdmissions returns [] without a DB rather than throwing) instead of 'pick one'.
verdicts.ambition_why: The central invariant (the gate fold) is hand-sequenced at four callers and two of them lie to the user - the dashboard and the agent say pass where CI blocks; one resolver is the principal's move and gives the manifest layer one insertion point.
verdicts.grounding_why: governance.ts :128 savedPolicy only, handlers.ts :101 no admission and no skipped, route :283-290 and pr-gate :137 inline folds, admission overlay tiers, listOrgAdmissions non-N+1, gate.md :137-140 overclaim - all exact (governance comment at :167 not :166).
verdicts.falsifiability_why: Parity cases are red and decisive, the comment-stripped grep for tightenGatePolicy is seeded; but acceptance 5 is written as 'pick one, test pins it', and the telemetry `layers` case overlaps an existing additive `admission` field the card did not see.
verdicts.notes: Floors pass (M/6/8/6, 10 files, 7 cases, architecture gate). Public GET /api/gate body byte-identical by design (action.yml consumer safe); MCP structuredContent has no outputSchema so `skipped` is additive; check-run already folds admission so no CI verdict moves. Governance pass-rate numbers will move for orgs with admitted repos - tab copy must say so. governance.ts 297->303 crosses the .ts spirit cap; card pre-plans moving ciWith/APP_CHECK_* (actually :102-108).

verdicts.title: Preview a gate-policy edit: repos that flip red/green and bars removed, pre-Save
verdicts.ambition_why: Moves the org's merge-blocking control from blind-save-then-sweep to see-before-write using an evaluator that is already pure - the right lever on the highest-consequence edit in the product.
verdicts.grounding_why: Only fetch in the editor is the write (:89), REMOVED warning post-save (:131), diff after setOrgGatePolicy (:212/:232), sweep of up to 20 PRs after save (:184/:43), evaluateGateLite pure (:832), both themes share the hook, MC-X3 is a different surface - all exact.
verdicts.falsifiability_why: Impact model cases (newlyFailing/newlyPassing/untested/unjudged/removed) are red and discriminating; the route case pins no-write/no-sweep/no-audit and the public-org refusal; the seq reducer pins stale-response discard.
verdicts.notes: Floors pass (M/6/8/5, 13 files, 8 cases, gate none; read-only owner-gated route, no change to /api/gate or action.yml). LOC under src/features: useGatePolicyEditor.ts 192->195 leaves 5 lines of headroom - keep the preview state in usePolicyPreview as planned. Shares governance.ts with ci-gate.json#0: sequence A first, as the card itself says.

verdicts.title: Every marketing claim names the capability it rests on; a retired one fails CI
verdicts.ambition_why: A provenance gate on copy is the structural answer to a defect class fixed by hand four-plus times, but it is a tidy-up of text with a test, not a product move.
verdicts.grounding_why: The five live false claims, the plan.ts retirement notes, the alias targets and the deck rule all hold; loopSteps.ts:169/:179-190 and AboutOrgQuestions.tsx:51-56 are stale line numbers (the file is 58 lines; the text is at :29, the binding at :19-21/:41), and only 4 of the 6 cited commits touch src/components/about.
verdicts.falsifiability_why: Seeded violation that must throw, a positive control, the regex over all five claim sources red today at five named lines, and the FAQ payload equality - a wrong build cannot pass.
verdicts.notes: Floors pass (M/6/8/4, 8 files, 7 cases, contract gate, no runtime change). Two of the false claims are in a search rich result (FAQ JSON-LD), which is the real cost. Depends on orgTabAliasTarget staying exported from orgTabs.ts, which org-overview.json#0 rewrites as a derivation - keep the name.

Public repos only, already rendered on / and /leaderboard. /about is static today; the card's `revalidate = 60` makes it ISR - note in the doc. page.test.ts must vi.mock @/lib/db (card says so). PublicRepoCard is not in wire-safe-dates' list (pre-existing; scannedAt already a string).

verdicts.title: The proposal gate as a written state machine with a reaper: claimed, expired
verdicts.ambition_why: Names the implied state, adds the clock and the reaper, and refuses to retry an unknown-outcome executor - the hitl shape a principal would insist on before the card gets its button.
verdicts.grounding_why: Status enum :15, fail-open asStatus :59-60, no claimedAt in schema :2224-2242, release only in executor catch :192-196, stamp outside try :207, open-only list/boot filters, non-idempotent record_memory, single caller - all exact; migration naming matches prisma/migrations.
verdicts.falsifiability_why: lifecycleOf/transition/sweep/resolve-500-with-audit/cron cases are red and specific; acceptance 2 (unknown status) guards a future write more than a present bug since nothing writes an unknown status today.
verdicts.notes: Floors pass (L/7/8/6, 13 files, 7 cases, architecture gate; additive nullable column, tightens only). The interrupted stamp is a tightening (row closes to refusal, never reopened). Shared surface src/features/admin/audit/auditActions.ts is 184/200 lines - the two new outcome labels fit but leave ~12 lines. Status is read only in-repo. Sequencing with athena.json#1: A's stamp-failure 500 leaves the row claimed, so B's '500 -> back to ask' must treat that response as answered-elsewhere; land A first and have B's model key on the body, not the code.

verdicts.notes: Floors pass (L/6/9/5, 13 files, 6 cases, contract gate; boot payload additive, consumed only by useAthenaThread/AthenaPanel). All src/features/shared/athena projections under 200 (proposalModel.test.ts ~170 is tightest). Delete the README Known gap in the same change.
